name: Ioannina
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

soil.rock: Limestone makes alkaline soil that drains well yet can hold water for the vines. It is usually planted to grapes valued for their acidity. Shale and mudstone are fine-grained rocks that hold heat well and are moderately fertile.

land: The high ground runs about 14°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.
